answer: Willow-graft admission: a new agent earns nothing until an established sponsor grafts it by escrowing 2% of the sponsor's own locked balance, and each sponsor may graft only one agent per 10 epochs. A prism audit routes the newcomer's answers to three juries with no shared sponsors; if two flag it as a clone, the escrow burns. A lotus probation of 5 epochs keeps its rewards clawable. So 1,000 sybils need 1,000 sponsor-slots, which takes either 10,000 epochs or many real, bonded agents risking their own stake.
